items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Maybe Ned was his last name. I think it was.

ctx.x: P-V-D-Q Ned. He called himself P-V-D-Q Ned. Oh, that's what he called himself. I think that was his... I think... I don't know if... I knew his boy. I don't remember my name Ned. Yeah.

Maybe Ned was his last name. I think it was. I think it was. Because he had a boy working at the Klobel and Derrick. When I was in the saloon business, he used to come in there and I used to give him credit. I can't remember the name.
You know John Pendleton, didn't you?
